messages:
Zara (PM): Customer ask from HealthAnalytics: they want a single Console view to explain week-over-week spend changes, tie to deploys, and surface a couple representative trace envelopes. Need it to be exportable for finance. Quick MVP proposal: Spend Decomposition card (token driver, model change, traffic), Deploy overlay, two trace envelopes per flagged route, and export-to-PDF. Thoughts?

Liam (Eng): Agree with minimal scope. Implementation notes: derive per-route delta over two 7d windows, small aggregation job every 10m. Trace envelopes = {trace_id, route, error_code, token_summary, model_hint} only. Envelope payload <600B.

Priya (SRE): Ops constraints: default sampling 0.2%, retention 72h, per-org envelope quota 3k/day. Auto-throttle if envelopes/sec > baseline * 3 and an incident kill-switch in Console. Also require RBAC for export.

Anya (Data): Cost estimate = tokens * model_unit_cost(profile) + fixed overhead. We'll display a confidence band and show "Likely undercount for embedding-heavy routes" when classifier indicates embeddings. Also produce a small variance metric vs Billing.

Mika (UX): UI: Spend Decomposition card headline number (+$) + 3 horizontal bars (tokens, model, calls). Deploy overlay as small dots on timeline. Trace envelopes shown as one-line entries with a "Request raw traces" CTA. Export button -> PDF snapshot of card and timeline. Keep copy: "Estimate for diagnostics, not billing."

Zara (PM): Acceptance criteria: 1) Card shows top-5 delta routes with dollar delta and drivers, 2) Deploy overlay visible, 3) Up to 2 envelopes/route (no PII), 4) Export-to-PDF works in pilot, 5) Alerts + kill-switch in place, 6) Pilot with HealthAnalytics completed with no p95 regression. Owners: Liam backend + flag, Anya estimator, Priya ops + alerts, Mika UI + export, Zara pilot.

Liam (Eng): Feature-flag snippet: 
```yaml
console:
  spend_decomp:
    enabled: true
    delta_window_days: 7
    envelope:
      default_sampling: 0.002
      retention_days: 3
      per_org_quota: 3000
      max_payload_bytes: 600
    export_pdf: true
```
We'll gate on a canary rollout.

Priya (SRE): Alerts to add: `console.spend_decomp.envelope_surge` (envelopes/sec > baseline*3) and `console.spend_decomp.p95_regress` (p95 > 1.2x baseline). Also auto-reduce sampling by 10x on surge.

ConsoleBot: Created alert templates `console.spend_decomp.envelope_surge` and `console.spend_decomp.p95_regress`.
